en.text: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to the LORD, and said, “I will sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.

footnotes.text: 15:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，摩西和以色列人向耶和华唱歌说： 我要向耶和华歌唱，因他大大战胜， 将马和骑马的投在海中。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，摩西和以色列人向耶和華唱歌說： 我要向耶和華歌唱，因他大大戰勝， 將馬和騎馬的投在海中。

en.text: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华是我的力量，我的诗歌， 也成了我的拯救。 这是我的 神，我要赞美他， 是我父亲的 神，我要尊崇他。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華是我的力量，我的詩歌， 也成了我的拯救。 這是我的上帝，我要讚美他， 是我父親的上帝，我要尊崇他。

en.text: The LORD is a man of war. The LORD is his name.

footnotes.text: 15:3 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华是战士； 他的名是耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華是戰士； 他的名是耶和華。

en.text: He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.

zhSimplified.text: 法老的车辆、军兵，耶和华已抛在海中； 他特选的军长都沉于红海。

zhTraditional.text: 法老的車輛、軍兵，耶和華已拋在海中； 他特選的軍長都沉於紅海。

en.text: The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone.

zhSimplified.text: 深水淹没他们； 他们如同石头坠到深处。

zhTraditional.text: 深水淹沒他們； 他們如同石頭墜到深處。

en.text: Your right hand, LORD, is glorious in power. Your right hand, LORD, dashes the enemy in pieces.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你的右手施展能力，显出荣耀； 耶和华啊，你的右手摔碎仇敌。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你的右手施展能力，顯出榮耀； 耶和華啊，你的右手摔碎仇敵。

en.text: In the greatness of your excellency, you overthrow those who rise up against you. You send out your wrath. It consumes them as stubble.

zhSimplified.text: 你大发威严，推翻那些起来攻击你的； 你发出烈怒如火，烧灭他们像烧碎秸一样。

zhTraditional.text: 你大發威嚴，推翻那些起來攻擊你的； 你發出烈怒如火，燒滅他們像燒碎稭一樣。

en.text: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea.

zhSimplified.text: 你发鼻中的气，水便聚起成堆， 大水直立如垒， 海中的深水凝结。

zhTraditional.text: 你發鼻中的氣，水便聚起成堆， 大水直立如壘， 海中的深水凝結。

en.text: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword. My hand will destroy them.’

zhSimplified.text: 仇敌说：我要追赶，我要追上； 我要分掳物，我要在他们身上称我的心愿。 我要拔出刀来，亲手杀灭他们。

zhTraditional.text: 仇敵說：我要追趕，我要追上； 我要分擄物，我要在他們身上稱我的心願。 我要拔出刀來，親手殺滅他們。

en.text: You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.

zhSimplified.text: 你叫风一吹，海就把他们淹没； 他们如铅沉在大水之中。

zhTraditional.text: 你叫風一吹，海就把他們淹沒； 他們如鉛沉在大水之中。

en.text: Who is like you, LORD, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，众神之中，谁能像你？ 谁能像你—至圣至荣， 可颂可畏，施行奇事？

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，眾神之中，誰能像你？ 誰能像你－至聖至榮， 可頌可畏，施行奇事？

en.text: You stretched out your right hand. The earth swallowed them.

zhSimplified.text: 你伸出右手， 地便吞灭他们。

zhTraditional.text: 你伸出右手， 地便吞滅他們。

en.text: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.

zhSimplified.text: 你凭慈爱领了你所赎的百姓； 你凭能力引他们到了你的圣所。

zhTraditional.text: 你憑慈愛領了你所贖的百姓； 你憑能力引他們到了你的聖所。

en.text: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.

zhSimplified.text: 外邦人听见就发颤； 疼痛抓住非利士的居民。

zhTraditional.text: 外邦人聽見就發顫； 疼痛抓住非利士的居民。

en.text: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，以东的族长惊惶， 摩押的英雄被战兢抓住， 迦南的居民心都消化了。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，以東的族長驚惶， 摩押的英雄被戰兢抓住， 迦南的居民心都消化了。

en.text: Terror and dread falls on them. By the greatness of your arm they are as still as a stone, until your people pass over, LORD, until the people you have purchased pass over.

zhSimplified.text: 惊骇恐惧临到他们。 耶和华啊，因你膀臂的大能， 他们如石头寂然不动， 等候你的百姓过去， 等候你所赎的百姓过去。

zhTraditional.text: 驚駭恐懼臨到他們。 耶和華啊，因你膀臂的大能， 他們如石頭寂然不動， 等候你的百姓過去， 等候你所贖的百姓過去。

en.text: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, LORD, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.

zhSimplified.text: 你要将他们领进去，栽于你产业的山上— 耶和华啊，就是你为自己所造的住处； 主啊，就是你手所建立的圣所。

zhTraditional.text: 你要將他們領進去，栽於你產業的山上－ 耶和華啊，就是你為自己所造的住處； 主啊，就是你手所建立的聖所。

en.text: The LORD will reign forever and ever.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必作王，直到永永远远！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必作王，直到永永遠遠！

en.text: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea.

zhSimplified.text: 法老的马匹、车辆，和马兵下到海中，耶和华使海水回流，淹没他们；惟有以色列人在海中走干地。

zhTraditional.text: 法老的馬匹、車輛，和馬兵下到海中，耶和華使海水回流，淹沒他們；惟有以色列人在海中走乾地。

en.text: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伦的姊姊，女先知米利暗，手里拿着鼓；众妇女也跟她出去拿鼓跳舞。

zhTraditional.text: 亞倫的姊姊，女先知米利暗，手裏拿着鼓；眾婦女也跟她出去拿鼓跳舞。

en.text: Miriam answered them, “Sing to the LORD, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.”

zhSimplified.text: 米利暗应声说： 你们要歌颂耶和华，因他大大战胜， 将马和骑马的投在海中。

zhTraditional.text: 米利暗應聲說： 你們要歌頌耶和華，因他大大戰勝， 將馬和騎馬的投在海中。

en.text: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西领以色列人从红海往前行，到了书珥的旷野，在旷野走了三天，找不着水。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西領以色列人從紅海往前行，到了書珥的曠野，在曠野走了三天，找不着水。

en.text: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.

zhSimplified.text: 到了玛拉，不能喝那里的水；因为水苦，所以那地名叫玛拉。

zhTraditional.text: 到了瑪拉，不能喝那裏的水；因為水苦，所以那地名叫瑪拉。

en.text: The people murmured against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”

zhSimplified.text: 百姓就向摩西发怨言，说：「我们喝什么呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 百姓就向摩西發怨言，說：「我們喝甚麼呢？」

en.text: Then he cried to the LORD. The LORD showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西呼求耶和华，耶和华指示他一棵树。他把树丢在水里，水就变甜了。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西呼求耶和華，耶和華指示他一棵樹。他把樹丟在水裏，水就變甜了。

en.text: He said, “If you will diligently listen to the LORD your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am the LORD who heals you.”

zhSimplified.text: 又说：「你若留意听耶和华—你 神的话，又行我眼中看为正的事，留心听我的诫命，守我一切的律例，我就不将所加与埃及人的疾病加在你身上，因为我—耶和华是医治你的。」

zhTraditional.text: 又說：「你若留意聽耶和華－你上帝的話，又行我眼中看為正的事，留心聽我的誡命，守我一切的律例，我就不將所加與埃及人的疾病加在你身上，因為我－耶和華是醫治你的。」

en.text: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.

zhSimplified.text: 他们到了以琳，在那里有十二股水泉，七十棵棕树；他们就在那里的水边安营。

zhTraditional.text: 他們到了以琳，在那裏有十二股水泉，七十棵棕樹；他們就在那裏的水邊安營。
